list: The official 55 trophies, 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze, 28 hidden on PlayStation until earned. Names, descriptions and grades as PlayStation publishes them (Exophase and PSNProfiles agree on all 55); counts are PSN's tracked targets. Guides are this entry's own words.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum is the last trophy you earn: it pops the moment the other 54 are done, so there is nothing to do for it directly. Work the roadmap in order — story first, then character strands and strangers, then the counted clean-up — and treat A Long Road (100% completion) as the real final boss. There are no online or DLC trophies, so the whole list is completable solo on one save.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing to the end; it unlocks as part of the story and cannot be missed. It is the first trophy most players earn, and the start of Chapter 1.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1 and the chapter-complete trophy pops. Before the chapter closes, do the Chapter 1 meditation spot for Positive Mental Attitude — GTABase and PowerPyx flag it as the list's only possibly missable trophy, because that spot disappears after Chapter 1.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2 in full. By now both Jason and Lucia are playable, which opens most of the list's side content — use the chapter to try the activities that feed Master of None, one try of each type.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. Story trophies unlock by playing the missions; there is no mission replay, so play each mission as it comes — nothing here can be failed permanently, only left unfinished.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. You are one chapter from the finale; before the final mission, check the character strands listed under Characters — their final missions are the ones this guide tracks separately, and it is cleaner to finish open strands before the credits roll.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission. Once the credits roll, free roam continues, so everything outside the story stays available afterwards — the finale is a door, not a deadline. Push Square notes the 100% completion checklist unlocks once the story is finished, which is when the real clean-up begins.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Play the mission Breakfast Run to its end. It is a story mission, so it unlocks by playing through the story in order; the trophy pops when the mission completes.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Play The Cartel Heist to its end. A story mission — it unlocks in order, and the official description names no special preparation, so play it as it comes.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Play the mission Child's Play to its end. Story mission, unlocked in order; the trophy pops on completion.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Play the mission Headliners to its end. Story mission, unlocked in order; the trophy pops on completion.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Play the mission VCIA Takedown to its end. VCIA is the airport, so this mission introduces the area that Catch Me If You Can later uses — remember the layout when you come back in free roam.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Play the mission Operation Savage Glory to its end. Story mission, unlocked in order; the trophy pops on completion.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion — the hardest trophy on the list by every guide's ranking, worth 100G on Xbox. The in-game 100% checklist unlocks only after the story, so plan this as a post-story clean-up: stunts, ranges, collectibles, areas and challenges all feed it. GTABase puts the platinum at around 200 hours and Push Square at 300 or more; either way this is the long tail, not a sprint.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Land 250 stunts across Leonida — jumps, near-misses and airtime all count toward the total the game tracks. Spread them through the whole playthrough instead of grinding them at the end: every drive is a chance to add to the count. PSN tracks the running total, so check your progress in the trophy list as you go.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once — fishing, arcade games, drone racing, shooting ranges, bowling, meditation and the rest of the activities this guide lists. One try each is enough; you do not need to win or master any of them for this trophy.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Work range by range and learn each challenge's scoring before chasing gold — bronze and silver runs teach the layout first. Every one of the 42 must be gold, not just most of them, which is why guides rank this among the hardest silvers.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations. Learn each course once before racing it for the win, and treat the first win at a new location as the goal — the trophy counts locations, not total wins.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — different events, not the same race 20 times. Mix race types and locations; each new event you win adds one to the count.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fish the challenge, watch how Cal scores, and replay it until your catch beats his — the trophy is about one head-to-head win, not a fishing career.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game all the way through. Pick the shortest game on the machine and play it to its end screen — one completion is all the trophy asks.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Play Andy's mission strand to its final mission and complete it. Character strands unlock as the story introduces each character — follow Andy's missions whenever they appear and the finale comes in order.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Play Kenton's mission strand to its final mission and complete it. Follow Kenton's missions whenever they appear; the finale is the last one in his strand.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Play Billy's mission strand to its final mission and complete it. Follow Billy's missions whenever they appear; the finale is the last one in his strand.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Stranger missions appear around the map as you explore — start each one you meet and see its strand through; 8 finished strands is the count, not 8 single missions. GTABase notes stranger missions are not part of 100% completion, so do them for this trophy, not for A Long Road.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Play Randy's mission strand to its final mission and complete it. Follow Randy's missions whenever they appear; the finale is the last one in his strand.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Play Tyrone's mission strand to its final mission and complete it. Follow Tyrone's missions whenever they appear; the finale is the last one in his strand.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every one of the 18 spots across Leonida. This is the one possibly missable trophy on the list: GTABase and PowerPyx both flag it, because Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 disappears after that chapter — do it before Chapter 1 closes. After that, sweep the remaining spots in free roam; meditation spots are places, so treat this as a collectible hunt with a deadline on the first one.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's strand points you at the animal — follow his missions, and take the shot when the unique animal is in front of you; the trophy is about the one hunt, not general hunting.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are hidden around Leonida; a set is complete when every card in it is found, and three finished sets pop the trophy. Track which sets you have finished — the game counts sets, not single cards, so a half-finished set earns nothing yet.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK spots are scattered across the state — use them whenever you pass one, and the count climbs without a dedicated grind. Fold it into the exploration sweep for The Goodtime State so one trip serves two trophies.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are the game's side objectives; any 50 count, so do the ones that fit what you are already doing and let the total build up across the playthrough.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level and then lose it and escape. Pick a quiet stretch of road, raise the heat to four stars with your partner in the car, then break line of sight and stay hidden until the stars clear — the escape is the trophy, not the chase.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops back-to-back without losing your wanted level. Plan a route past three shops, keep the robberies quick, and keep moving — the streak breaks if the wanted level drops between shops, so do all three in one run.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Every new vehicle you drive counts once — drive everything you find, and the count climbs through normal play. The trophy tracks discovery, not ownership, so you do not need to keep or buy them.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: In a single use of Combat Focus, take down 5 enemies. Wait for a group of at least five, trigger Combat Focus, and chain the five takedowns before it ends — one clean activation with five downs is the whole trophy.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — leave the airport in a way the schedule never planned. The description is deliberately vague; the airport is the place, and an unplanned exit is the deed. Try it in free roam, when nothing else is pulling you back.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The description is a joke with a hint: 'Kinda hot in these Rhinos.' Rhinos are the tanks — get into trouble with one, or around one, and the trophy follows the encounter. The exact trigger is not pinned down in the sources checked; treat any Rhino run-in as progress toward it.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet, stay out of sight lines, take the goods and leave before anyone raises the alarm — detection, not speed, is what fails it.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape — five separate vault jobs, each ending in a clean getaway. Learn one vault's layout, escape cleanly, then repeat at the next; the trophy counts completed escapes, not attempts.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Hit the truck, take the haul, and break away before the response closes in — one truck, one clean escape.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. The map fills in as you travel; the trophy pops when the last area is discovered. Sweep the edges of the map in free roam after the story, when nothing is pulling you back to missions, and pair the sweep with the WAiNK spots and meditation spots.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. One operation per gang — nine gangs, nine robberies. Learn which operations belong to which gang and work through the list one gang at a time.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Go to Ocean Beach, find the bar with the view, order the cocktail and take in the sunset — a quiet trophy, and the easiest one on the list.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive into the showroom, then drive straight back out through the glass — the trophy is the exit, not the entrance.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Go to the alley and bowl a game — follow-through is the hint, so finish your throw properly rather than rushing it.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: The description is a riddle — 'A partnership with mass appeal.' Partnerships run through this list (your partner in Hot Together and Retail Therapy), so look for a co-op moment with your partner that draws a crowd. The exact trigger is not pinned down in the sources checked; this guide will name it once a source confirms it.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). PSN tracks a count toward 500 for this one — the trophy is about the volume of choices across the game, not one big decision. Play naturally, make choices whenever the game offers them, and the count climbs.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. The description hints at succeeding on a second attempt — fail something, then clear it on the retry. The exact trigger is not pinned down in the sources checked; this guide will name it once a source confirms it.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? Something strange is out there in Leonida — a sighting, an encounter, a moment that makes no sense. Keep your eyes open while exploring, especially off the beaten path; the trophy pops when you witness it.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Line up a target on foot, drive past, and land the melee hit from the moving vehicle — one clean drive-by knockdown.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists — pass them through your contacts to clean them, and the earnings stack toward $250,000. It is a slow count, so launder as you go instead of saving it for the end.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Shops, clothes, gear — every dollar spent anywhere counts toward the total. Big purchases (vehicles, property) move the number fastest, but the trophy counts all spending, so the garages for Little Boxes help here too.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Garages are the safe place for the vehicles you collect — buy each one as it comes on the market, and the trophy pops with the eighth deed. Garage spending also counts toward Treat Yo Self.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find ten different vehicles, register each in the app, and the trophy pops at ten — discovery and registration are two different steps, so remember to open the app after each find.
